Teslas have superhuman vision

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Rustavi (@Rustavi); megjelent: 2026-11-25T18:46:24+00:00; link: https://x.com/Rustavi/status/2125662404541337779; média: videó, 42 másodperc]
🚨 FSD v15 in heavy rain: your eyes see chaos. The AI sees everything.
While the windshield is flooded with water, glare, and blur, FSD v15’s visualization stays locked, perfectly tracking every vehicle and the blue path ahead. Even with the ‘Camera Visibility Limited’ warning, it keeps driving with precision.
This is what next-level perception looks like. 🌧️🚗
